Batman the movie 1989 Christian Wolf La'Moy driving the 1973 Chevrolet Impala 350 Custom Coupe Green on Green . That construction truck hit the Chevy hard. One of my Joker's cars (Dodge 3700GT was badly damaged in this Stunt!

Christian Wolf La'Moy on the Pinewood lot Batman movie 1988/9 Gotham city street. With my two identical Dodge 3700GT "Jokers cars" I aquired the cars in Spain and my brother and i drove them 2000 miles aross europe to Pinewood Studios. We drove cars & trucks in many of the stunts in the film.
